title: EncoderConfig
description: Vulkan Video Encoder configuration. JSON is loaded first (base config); command-line parameters override. Source: VkEncoderConfig (EncoderConfig), encoder_config.example.json in this directory.

codec.description: Video codec. hevc treated as h265.

outputPath.description: Bitstream output file path. Empty: the command line's -o.

encodeWidth.description: Encode output width. 0: the input's width.

encodeHeight.description: Encode output height. 0: the input's height.

vbvBufferSize.description: VBV/HRD buffer size in bits. 0 = auto.

constQpI.description: Constant QP for I frames. -1 or 0: the driver's preferred QP.

constQpP.description: Constant QP for P frames. -1 or 0: the driver's preferred QP.

constQpB.description: Constant QP for B frames. -1 or 0: the driver's preferred QP.

qp.description: Single constant QP (I/P). -1 or 0: the driver's preferred QP.

gopLength.description: Frames per GOP; 0 is the device's preferred length.

idrPeriod.description: Frames between IDRs; 0 is the device's preferred period.

psnr.description: PSNR input vs reconstructed (same as CLI --psnr).

crcInit.description: CRC32 seed uint32s (e.g. 4294967295 and 0 for OGTEST-style); same as CLI --crcInit comma-separated list.
